content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Courses teachable

Stripe offers a comprehensive payment processing solution, but it operates in only 46 countries, leaving a vast majority of the globe underserved. Teachable provides an all-in-one platform for course creation and sales but relies on Stripe for payment processing, effectively excluding creators in restricted regions. Such limitations force creators to navigate complex barriers, limiting their ability to sell digital products efficiently. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure enables creators to build their own online stores using free tools, ensuring they retain full control over their sales and customer relationships. This approach circumvents the restrictions imposed by conventional platforms, allowing creators to thrive regardless of their geographic location.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal impose geographic restrictions that prevent many creators from accessing their services. For instance, PayPal suspensions can lock funds for up to 180 days with no recourse, creating significant financial uncertainty. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed specifically for creators in restricted countries, providing a reliable alternative that doesn’t depend on corporate approval. With tools like Cloudflare Workers and Supabase, creators can set up payment processing that works without these geographic limitations. This means they can sell their courses and digital products without worrying about account restrictions or fund holds.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed is crucial for creators depending on timely revenue. Stripe offers fast processing times, yet those in restricted countries can face delays and denials. Its fees, while competitive, can add up quickly, especially for smaller transactions. PayPal, on the other hand, can freeze funds, leading to unexpected cash flow issues. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, utilizing NOWPayments for crypto transactions, charges only a 0.5% fee and processes payments instantly without the risk of account holds. This allows creators to efficiently manage their finances and avoid the pitfalls of traditional payment platforms, making it a more attractive option for those outside standard markets.
Sovereign infrastructure means full ownership of your sales process.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the most significant downsides of using platforms like Teachable or Stripe is that creators do not own their infrastructure. They are subject to platform rules, fee changes, and potential service discontinuation. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure allows full ownership of the sales process. Creators can automate delivery using tools like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring that products reach customers immediately upon purchase. This level of control not only secures the creator's revenue but also fosters a stronger relationship with their audience, as they can manage everything from payment to delivery without third-party interference.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture hinges on your specific needs and the restrictions imposed by your location. For those in restricted countries, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a robust solution, allowing you to deploy an online store in just 48 hours with no reliance on traditional payment systems. It provides full integration with NOWPayments for instant crypto processing, ensuring you can reach customers globally without the risk of account issues. If you simply need documentation and a foundation to build from, the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides comprehensive guidance to get started. Evaluate your situation and opt for the architecture that aligns best with your goals.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, consider using sovereign commerce infrastructure. By leveraging tools like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, you can create a self-hosted store that processes payments in cryptocurrencies, providing a reliable and accessible alternative. This approach eliminates the dependence on restrictive platforms, giving you full control over your sales.
Cut out the middleman and keep more profits with low transaction fees.

Start by assessing your specific needs and restrictions. Next, choose the right sovereign commerce stack that fits your situation. Test your purchase process end-to-end before going live. Finally, launch your store and begin selling with confidence.
